text: 402 removes actionsshared and its jar entry. Review reports it unused beforev60; fixed accepted grep finds no actionsshared references in mail/components/preferences. Bug 1901705 uses coverage plus caller/package checks during post128 cleanup. Keep source and package wiring consistent when removing a proven unused helper. Coverage alone does not prove all runtime paths absent; no instrumentation run by this study.
title: Do not infer live runtime use from a packaged old helper alone
